text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: I won't lose...! —Haaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(What the?! Shivers down my spine...! It's 
like a wave of flames is closing in...!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(Every drop of blood in my body feels like 
it's about to explode!! What is this, what 
on earth is this...!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —It's so intense...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, the level of competition this year 
is insane! All those top-class Junior 
division runners together, and pulling off 
that performance... Epi is crazy good!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, she's crazy powerful... Her raw 
talent is just on another level.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Epi is related to Cesario!? I 
was rooting for her~! Whoa, now I wanna 
know even more about this girl!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as expected. Epi-san really has 
that special flair that draws people in."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no way I could imitate that. 
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: I'll do things my own way.

text_block_list.name: Watching Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...My heart is pounding. Could the destiny 
Epi-chan mentioned be...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After delivering a performance true to 
expectations, all eyes are on Epiphaneia. 
Naturally, if she keeps winning on the 
grand stage of GⅠ races—
choice_data_list:
(Could it be... that I've been bestowed a 
destiny?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding onto hope that her dream would 
come true, I looked toward Epiphaneia—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Racing is so heated!! It's a massive 
eruption!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I get it now! I felt what they 
call pressure right on my back!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere was completely different 
from the previous race! Everyone was 
closing in with such supreme confidence—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"There are actually girls who can go 
toe-to-toe with me! GⅠ races are 
incredible!"
choice_data_list: (...I see, so that's how it is.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she boasts with such confidence, 
Epiphaneia is exceptionally talented. 
There must have been countless times when 
her sheer ability set her apart from the 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet today, by experiencing the top tier of 
her generation firsthand—she was able to 
feel the raw, burning passion of racing 
deep in her bones.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I want to win! I want to win lots and 
lots!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Next year's Classic races... will be an 
even more amazing show!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If you win in an incredible race, everyone 
will feel the hand of destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOO! I want to win!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ! Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Epi-san. So you hadn't headed back 
yet~."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You came to cheer for me! Thank you!
choice_data_list: (She doesn't suspect a thing, does she...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: So, how was it!? Pretty awesome, wasn't I!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. As expected of you, 
Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"The power you possess is wonderful. 
And... truly formidable."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Right on!!!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's why... I've refocused my 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's you, Epi-san— I'm taking the 
Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Logo, your eyes are burning hot too...! 
Are you trying to incinerate me 
completely!?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Huh? Does it feel that way to you~?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
It's a little embarrassing. I guess my 
feelings were completely leaking out... 
haha.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it burns me up, I want to win. 
It's the 'Satsuki Sho', after all~."
choice_data_list: Is this a special race to you?
Is this a special race to you?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Special. ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"If I win, I'll be able to get so many 
people to notice me, after all."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ! A signboard!!!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My family runs a sign shop, you 
know. Have you ever seen any hand-painted 
signs around town?
choice_data_list:
...Maybe I've seen it at the shopping 
district or something?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, like the signboards outside 
shops. We make things based on whatever 
vibe you have in mind~.
choice_data_list: That's a pretty unusual job, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right! I only found out after hearing it 
from Logo too!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
You don't see that very often, do you~? 
So... what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
The sign you just pictured in your mind. I 
bet... it felt really warm and full of 
character, right?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"Aside from signboards, if you look around 
town... you'll find so many wonderful, 
time-honored things crafted by artisans' 
hands."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
They might not be in style, but I know 
people would love them if they just gave 
them a chance. I want to bring those kinds 
of things into the spotlight.
choice_data_list: Is that to promote it, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"If you win, all eyes are on you, right? 
Even more so if it's on a grand stage like 
a GⅠ."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
If they get interested in me and look into 
it—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I believe we can connect all the things we 
love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Logotype's eyes gleamed brightly. 
Different from Epiphaneia... she was 
filled with a fresh, vibrant conviction.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's a great dream! I'm rooting for you 
too!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Well, that's how it 
is...

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I'll grow even more by next year, so let's 
have a great race~.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: ...I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Logotype left... Epiphaneia was 
burning with fire.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll surpass Logo's heat! If I win, I can 
make everyone believe in destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! Let's do this, do this, do 
this!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is finally on the 
Classic Triple Crown trail— the Satsuki 
Sho.
